report_name: Q3 2026 Shatters Records with 2,627 Ransomware Attacks

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware campaigns were observed deleting volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin.exe to prevent system restoration.

attack_patterns.name: Clear Windows Event Logs
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware operators were observed clearing Windows Event Logs using 'wevtutil.exe cl' to cover their tracks.

attack_patterns.name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
attack_patterns.description: Attackers use tools like PsExec, which leverages SMB/Windows Admin Shares, for lateral movement within victim networks.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Attackers abuse Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) for lateral movement between workstations and servers.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The primary impact of the ransomware attacks is the encryption of critical files and systems, often followed by the creation of ransom notes.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by ransomware operators to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: wevtutil
tools.description: Used by attackers to clear Windows Event Logs to cover their tracks.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: Used by attackers for lateral movement within compromised networks.

tools.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
tools.description: Abused by attackers for lateral movement between workstations and servers.

infrastructure.name: Cloud Storage for Exfiltration
infrastructure.description: Attackers exfiltrate large amounts of data to unknown cloud storage providers before encrypting victim systems to facilitate double and triple extortion tactics.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a7e4b-5b1f-4b8e-8e4a-9b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to prevent recovery.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/q3-new-record-ransomware/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-09
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command used to delete volume shadow copies to prevent system restoration, a common ransomware precursor.

indicators.name: Windows Event Log Clearing with wevtutil
indicators.pattern:
title: Windows Event Log Clearing with wevtutil
id: 3c9b8f5c-6c2g-5c9f-9f5b-ac2d3e4f5a6b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of wevtutil.exe to clear event logs, a common technique for covering tracks.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/q3-new-record-ransomware/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-09
tags:
  - attack.t1070.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' cl '
      - ' clear-log '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command used to clear event logs to hide malicious activity.

indicators.name: Common Ransom Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Common Ransom Note File Creation
id: 4d0c9g6d-7d3h-6d0g-ag6c-bd3e4f5a6b7c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with names commonly used for ransomware notes.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/q3-new-record-ransomware/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-09
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'README.txt'
      - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.html'
      - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of common ransom note files, indicating a likely ransomware encryption event.
